title: DNA binding, and apoptosis-inducing activities of a beta-ionone-derived ester in human myeloid leukemia cells: multispectral and molecular dynamic simulation analyses.
authors: Jahanbakhsh, Kamran; Ansari-Ahl, Ramin; Mashhadi, Benyamin; Zare, Monireh; Samarkhazan, Nastaran Sedghi; Kazemzadeh, Hamid; Dehghan, Gholamreza; Dehkordi, Mahvash Farajzadeh; Gharaghani, Sajjad; Mahdavi, Majid
one_liner_zh: 该文研究β-紫罗兰酮衍生物酯与DNA的小沟结合及凋亡诱导活性，采用多光谱、分子对接和分子动力学模拟，虽为小分子-DNA互作而非TF-DNA体系，但MD/对接方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作建模。
abstract: beta-Ionone is the end-ring counterpart of beta-carotenoids, which are widely found in fruits and vegetables. Recent studies have illustrated the antimetastatic, anti-proliferative, and apoptosis-inducing activities of beta-ionone both in vitro and in vivo. We aimed to explore the anti-cancer potency of beta-Ionone-derived ester, (E)-4-(2,6,6-trimethylcyclohex-1-enyl) but-3-en-2-ylpyrazine-2-carboxylate (4-TM.P). The cytotoxic effects of the compound on K562 cells were evaluated by MTT assay. The mechanisms of apoptosis induction were investigated by acridine orange/ethidium bromide (AO/EtBr) double staining, cell cycle analysis, and Annexin V/PI staining. Furthermore, the 4-TM.P-DNA interactions have been thoroughly elucidated by various methods, such as ultraviolet-visible spectroscopy, fluorescence assays, viscosity measurements, molecular docking, and dynamic simulation. The MTT cytotoxicity assay revealed that the growth of K562 cells was inhibited by treatment with beta-ionone-derived ester, with an IC50 of 25 +/- 5.0 microM at 72 h. Morphological studies revealed the occurrence of apoptosis in treated cells, and G0/G1 cell cycle arrest was observed after treatment of the cells with the IC50 value of the compound. Analyses of multi-spectroscopy and viscosity assays revealed that 4-TM.P binds to DNA in the minor groove mode, which was supported by molecular docking studies. The dynamic stability of the complex was also confirmed using molecular dynamic simulation analyses.
abstract_zh: β-紫罗酮（beta-Ionone）是β-胡萝卜素类化合物的末端环对应物，广泛存在于水果和蔬菜中。近期研究表明，β-紫罗酮在体外和体内均具有抗转移、抗增殖及诱导凋亡的活性。本研究旨在探讨β-紫罗酮衍生物酯类化合物（E）-4-(2,6,6-三甲基环己-1-烯基)丁-3-烯-2-基吡嗪-2-羧酸酯（4-TM.P）的抗癌潜力。通过MTT实验评估该化合物对K562细胞的细胞毒性作用。采用吖啶橙/溴化乙锭（AO/EtBr）双染、细胞周期分析及Annexin V/PI染色研究凋亡诱导机制。此外，通过紫外-可见光谱、荧光分析、粘度测量、分子对接及动态模拟等多种方法，全面阐明了4-TM.P与DNA的相互作用。MTT细胞毒性实验显示，β-紫罗酮衍生物酯类处理可抑制K562细胞生长，72小时时的半数抑制浓度（IC50）为25 ± 5.0微摩尔。形态学研究表明处理细胞发生凋亡，且以该化合物IC50浓度处理后观察到G0/G1期细胞周期阻滞。多光谱及粘度分析结果表明，4-TM.P以小沟结合模式与DNA结合，分子对接研究进一步支持了这一结论。分子动态模拟分析也确认了复合物的动态稳定性。
